title: Activate approved M0-M9 checkpoint graph
objective: Activate the approved M0-M9 build graph as machine-readable Forge state while preserving legacy history and preventing software milestones from changing therapeutic Program state.
forbidden_actions: inherit a legacy completion or evidence status
change a formal Foundry Program stage
read, rotate, install, or reuse credentials
change repository visibility, branch protection, or merge policy
deploy to production or authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or regulated action

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical milestone inventory is exactly M0-M9 in approved dependency order.
The active mandate binds the exact plan digest, repository head, three human sign-offs, and distinct independent review.
Legacy checkpoint state and schema are archived and bound to exact digests.
All P0-P7, B0/B0.5/B1/B2, and namespaced legacy F1-F10 labels map completely with status inheritance disabled.
Program F0-F12 coverage remains separately namespaced and the migration changes no Program state.
M0 remains incomplete pending protected merge and no product capability is overstated.
Completion requires verified durable evidence, completed dependencies, and no applicable open blocker.
Work-item schemas, templates, and operating documents use M milestones while preserving stable legacy work-item IDs.
Adversarial mutations of inventory, graph, digests, approval, review, evidence, mapping, blocker, and Program boundaries fail closed.
All governed local validation commands pass before publication.
A distinct reviewer evaluates the exact published head before protected merge.

protected_actions: approve or merge the pull request
activate the mandate before protected-baseline evidence exists
complete M0 within the migration pull request
change a therapeutic Program record or gate
configure repository visibility, branch protection, or required checks
